name: heavy-armor-red-purple-unaffected
about: v0.58: Heavy Armor Red/Purple (BS17-035, printed: unaffected by opposing Red/Purple Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects). The player's red BS20-005 (When Summoned: destroy an opposing Spirit with 4000 BP or less) can only choose the other opposing Spirit; the red Magic BS20-074 (destroy BP 10000 or less) has no target while only the armored Spirit is left.
